name: yatmo-sdk-js
description: Workspace of the Yatmo JavaScript packages: @yatmo/sdk (API client), @yatmo/maps (browser plugins), @yatmo/elements (web components) and @yatmo/react (React components).

scripts.build: npm run build -w @yatmo/sdk && npm run build -w @yatmo/maps && npm run build -w @yatmo/elements && npm run build -w @yatmo/react && npm run build -w @yatmo/vue
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @yatmo/sdk && npm run build -w @yatmo/maps && npm run typecheck -w @yatmo/elements && npm run typecheck -w @yatmo/react && npm run typecheck -w @yatmo/vue
